title: Keep templates declarative, typed, and accessible
statement: Use Angular control flow and bindings for presentation, keep calculations in typed component state, provide semantic elements and accessible names, and avoid inline styles or imperative DOM manipulation.
rationale: Quality Studio templates remain readable when they describe structure and state while TypeScript owns calculations. Native semantics preserve keyboard and assistive-technology behavior.

history.change: Initial Angular template-hygiene seed grounded in Quality Studio templates.
